theme: Luxurious Balinese Royal Wedding (Red, Gold & Obsidian Black)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning Balinese Royal Wedding digital invitation (Undangan Digital) for Lira & Febi in ReactJS. Must include: 1) Opening Cover modal/screen with guest name customization ('Untuk Bapak/Ibu/Saudara/i') and 'Buka Undangan' button that triggers background audio (with audio player toggle supporting custom audio URL input); 2) Couple Story & Profile section for Lira Nuraulia Asdwiningtyas, S.Psi. (daughter of Bpk. Hadi Wiyono & Ibu Ni Wayan Rindiasih) and Febi Herlis Setiawan, S.Ak. (son of Bpk. Heriyanto & Ibu Liestari); 3) Countdown timer to 01 November 2026; 4) Event Schedule for Akad (10:00 WIB - selesai) and Resepsi (13:00 - 16:30 WIB) at Balai Sarmili, Depok with direct Google Maps link (https://maps.app.goo.gl/yNbbxjNhwcBPoaVZ7?g_st=ic); 5) Photo Gallery featuring uploaded couple photos in red, gold, and black Balinese traditional attire with lightbox modal; 6) RSVP & Wishes guestbook with live message posting; 7) Repeatable WhatsApp Share generator widget allowing guests to easily copy or share personalized invitation links with guest names; 8) Custom music URL input box allowing users to paste their own song URL anytime. Use Tailwind CSS with dark obsidian background (#0F0E0E), deep red (#8B0000), and royal gold accents (#D4AF37). Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You must not use full transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp royal buttons with hover animations.
